name: slip_framing
description: SLIP (RFC 1055) framing for local client interface serial transport. Byte stuffing and frame delimiting.

vectors.name: slip_simple_frame
vectors.description: Simple data with no special bytes, wrapped with END markers.

vectors.name: slip_escape_end_byte
vectors.description: Data containing 0xC0 (END) must be escaped as ESC ESC_END.

vectors.name: slip_escape_esc_byte
vectors.description: Data containing 0xDB (ESC) must be escaped as ESC ESC_ESC.

vectors.name: slip_escape_both
vectors.description: Data containing both END and ESC bytes.

vectors.name: slip_decode_escaped_end
vectors.description: Decode frame with escaped END byte.

vectors.name: slip_decode_escaped_esc
vectors.description: Decode frame with escaped ESC byte.

vectors.name: slip_invalid_escape_sequence
vectors.description: ESC followed by invalid byte (not DC or DD) is protocol error.

vectors.name: slip_truncated_escape
vectors.description: ESC at end of frame without following byte is truncated.

vectors.name: slip_empty_frame
vectors.description: Two consecutive END bytes = empty frame. May be ignored or treated as sync.

expected.note: Empty frames between ENDs are allowed

vectors.name: slip_multiple_empty_frames
vectors.description: Multiple consecutive END bytes (line sync pattern).

vectors.name: slip_leading_end_strip
vectors.description: Data before first END is discarded (resync).

vectors.name: slip_max_frame_size
vectors.description: Maximum SLIP frame depends on underlying transport. LCI uses 2048 bytes.

expected.reason: worst case: all bytes escaped + 2 END markers

vectors.name: slip_zero_length_after_decode
vectors.description: Valid SLIP frame that decodes to zero bytes.
